## Volume

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FtG8oz4P5uSDJe4YkL5Um%2F%7B796842B4-A783-46A5-AB71-7E0EC4E474FD%7D.png?alt=media&amp;token=7edfbbc9-3920-4822-b860-8f5ed9c09be4" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Volume setting lets you choose the playback volume for the music player.

You can set any value from 0 to over 200, depending on how loud you want the audio to be.


# Set Loop Mode

{% hint style="warning" %}
This action requires a [Premium Subscription](/premium/premium-and-priority-hosting-plans#premium-plans) to function.
{% endhint %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FXXAhDmsVAm01zO2VtTGH%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=c479a94c-49a5-4b72-9bb1-dace3d03f479" alt="" width="333"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Set Loop Mode block allows you to change the loop mode of the music player to off, track, or queue.

## Server

This setting selects which server the action applies to. You have two options to choose from:

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="Current Server" %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FdZi7kCHWcPIzH3Vy7YTs%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=df700045-b8a4-47b7-8d57-9325b8adb8dd" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

When you choose the Current Server option, the selected loop mode will be applied to the server where the command is executed.
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Server ID" %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fnq7vvs73QqY5L1VKI6nd%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=7cafbf44-babc-4557-9d10-6d88823213f2" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

When you select the Server ID option, the selected loop mode will be applied to the server matching the provided ID.

### Server ID

In this field, you can enter the ID of the server where you want the selected loop mode to be applied. Variables can be used in this field.
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

## Loop Mode

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FV5Ecbq7s837D4hnNDpnQ%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=7a02cb89-2ced-4bd0-8a82-70b4b12247c9" alt="" width="375"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

This option allows you to set the loop mode of the player.

| Name       | Raw Value | Description                |
| ---------- | --------- | -------------------------- |
| Off        | 0         | Disables looping.          |
| Loop Track | 1         | Repeats the current track. |
| Loop Queue | 2         | Repeats the entire queue.  |

You can choose this with the dropdown menu, or use a variable that returns the raw value of the loop mode you would like to set in the "Loop Mode Variable" field.

## AutoLeave Status

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FVsid4IJBu958odPpuSGW%2F%7B6E5668A5-2EAC-46FF-8A81-04368C1848D3%7D.png?alt=media&amp;token=99d7df0c-086a-47a5-bb71-8621fcb406fb" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

In this option you can choose whether the bot should automatically leave the voice channel when the music queue ends. If set to Enabled, the bot will disconnect once there are no tracks left to play. If set to Disabled, the bot will remain in the voice channel even after the queue is empty.

## Remove Mode

This setting lets you choose how tracks should be removed from the music queue. You have three options to select from:

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="Remove Track at Position" %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FbwnRL4eF71NgaDYm8GjG%2F%7BA931A2EE-AFAA-4E6D-BF64-155ABF422256%7D.png?alt=media&amp;token=ded4eb09-8fff-4d8c-8fb2-bf291dd01bb9" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Removes a single track from the queue based on its position.

### Queue Position

Use the Queue Position field to specify which track should be removed. Position values start at 0, where 0 is the first track and 1 is the second track.
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Remove Range of Tracks" %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F2CclHTQ14dHtWbWH8eHv%2F%7B888C9D75-CC6C-4628-ABE9-D24912D2356C%7D.png?alt=media&amp;token=aa68bb32-ac96-4f1b-b2bf-e2d9a66cedcc" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Removes multiple tracks at once by specifying a start and end position.

### Start Position

The position of the first track to remove, included.

### End Position

The position of the last track to remove, included.
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Clear Entire Queue" %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FQ28GSkcyX2b48YLlDFKL%2F%7B13DD7515-A01F-417C-AA90-2087F677985C%7D.png?alt=media&amp;token=531d6d86-4490-4c78-8631-2f7ebd6363f0" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Removes all tracks from the queue.
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

# Apply Audio Filter

{% hint style="warning" %}
This action requires a [Premium Subscription](/premium/premium-and-priority-hosting-plans#premium-plans) to function.
{% endhint %}

The Apply Audio Filter action applies an audio filter to the current music player.

<div data-full-width="false"><figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FUffJiuPiaJ9UrhD7Qxj3%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=f943113a-cdae-4ec0-86c4-30b6ed66bcfe" alt="" width="375"><figcaption></figcaption></figure></div>

## Server

This setting selects which server the action applies to. You have two options to choose from:

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="Current Server" %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FdZi7kCHWcPIzH3Vy7YTs%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=df700045-b8a4-47b7-8d57-9325b8adb8dd" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

When you select the 'Current Server' option, the audio will be applied to the player in the current server.
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Server ID" %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fnq7vvs73QqY5L1VKI6nd%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=7cafbf44-babc-4557-9d10-6d88823213f2" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

When you select the Server ID option, the audio filter will be applied to the provided server ID's player.

### Server ID

In this field, you can enter the ID of the server where you want the audio filter to be applied to. Variables can be used in this field.
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

## Filter Type

In this field, you can select the type of audio filter to apply to the specified player.

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="Filters" %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FG9IvkcyINxgwgElSsR1e%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=896e8f39-1663-4648-8b3c-09059a83818f" alt="" width="375"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

When you select one of the default filters, the specified filter will be applied to the player. The available filters are:

| Filter Type  | Filter Description                           |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------- |
| Bass Boost   | Enhances low frequencies for deeper bass     |
| Nightcore    | Faster and higher pitched audio              |
| Vaporwave    | Slower and lower pitched audio (chill vibes) |
| 8D Audio     | Creates spatial/surround sound effect        |
| Tremolo      | Volume oscillation (wobble effect)           |
| Vibrato      | Pitch oscillation (warble effect)            |
| Karaoke      | Attempts to remove vocals from track         |
| Treble Boost | Enhances high frequencies                    |
| Chipmunk     | Very high pitched (Alvin and the Chipmunks)  |
| Daycore      | Opposite of nightcore (slower & lower)       |

### Intensity

In this field, you can choose the intensity level of the filter. This supports low, medium or high.
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Custom Pitch" %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FGzqqXqX0ZaDobJ8B3fPb%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=dd5b82a8-4abb-464d-a2df-b49e311ea9cb" alt="" width="375"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

When you select Custom Pitch, you are able to specify a custom pitch (how high or low the song sounds) for the music player.

### Pitch Value

This field allows you to specify a custom pitch for the music player. A value of 1.0 is normal, a higher value would equal a higher pitch, and a lower value would equal a lower pitch. Variables can be used in this field.
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Custom Speed" %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FyiiqJwXnvgbwJzeoRdcJ%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=7af72384-c1b0-4472-8d97-95a0f866bf18" alt="" width="375"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

When you select Custom Speed, you are able to specify a custom speed for the music player.

### Pitch Value

This field allows you to specify a custom speed for the music player. A value of 1.0 is normal, a higher value play faster, and a lower value would play slower. Variables can be used in this field.
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Custom Equalizer" %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FFo4RYwlLEly1bgM3AOy7%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=a0dd8789-82bf-45fb-84bc-9f7bbcfb76f6" alt="" width="375"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Custom Equalizer is an advanced feature that allows you to select a custom band and gain for your music player.

### Custom Equalizer Bands

In this field, you can enter a JSON array of band objects. There are 15 bands (0-14), and each band can be adjusted with the gain value. Valid values for gain range from -0.25 to 1.0, where -0.25 means the given band is completely muted, and 0.25 means the band is doubled. This can change the volume of the output.

{% hint style="info" %}
You can see more information on the custom equalizer feature [on LavaLink's docs](https://lavalink.dev/api/rest#equalizer).
{% endhint %}
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Reset/Clear All" %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FqTjWm7PWuwQ2nAReOu5n%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=e561b3cb-c24a-437d-bc4c-3e1580362bc1" alt="" width="375"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Reset / Clear All will clear all filters from the specified player.
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

# Search Tracks

{% hint style="warning" %}
This action requires a [Premium Subscription](/premium/premium-and-priority-hosting-plans#premium-plans) to function.
{% endhint %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FHyRMhtexIhVJcTcZbiIG%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=c847117d-4324-4052-b5b9-77ff585a8707" alt="" width="335"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Search Tracks action allows you to search tracks without adding them to the queue, and make the results available via the `{MusicSearch.*}` [object variable](/custom-commands-and-events/variables#music-objects).

## **Search Query or URL**

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FDh5BulxB2mJrGnidlaX6%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=2ae84dc7-008b-4118-a2a4-8f9945669c62" alt="" width="371"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

This field allows you to input a song name, artist, or direct URL to a supported platform. This includes playlist and album links from Spotify or Apple Music, as well as individual track URLs from other platforms. Variables can be used in this field.

## Max Results

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fzw5sGOEiU84cUOE5dnnJ%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=83bb38f0-a367-440d-adc4-95e7aaf00d2b" alt="" width="369"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

This field allows you to set the maximum amount of results that the search will return. This can be a natural number from 1-25. Variables that return numbers can be used here.

## Playlist Load Limit

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F5IQu2YovIBALDfC1haF5%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=4d6960d0-b9bc-4ed8-86db-dc11e8554fc8" alt="" width="374"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

This field allows you to specify the maximum amount of songs that will be loaded from a playlist or album. This can be a natural number from 1-250. Variables that return numbers can be used here.

## Optional Variable

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FbXVGkezNyrwp4ZtnUucf%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=68b04406-5712-4b56-b0b2-f87a3cdc8d9c" alt="" width="369"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

This field allows you to specify a custom variable to use instead of the default `{MusicSearch.*}` variable. The tracks will be accessible through dot notation as `{yourVariableName_0.title}`, `{yourVariableName_1.title}`, etc.


# Voice Actions

Voice actions are all meant to target users in a voice channel. These actions can be various things that only affects a user inside a voice channel.

{% hint style="info" %}
Any of these actions can only target voice channel's or be used if a user / bot is in a voice channel.
{% endhint %}

| Block                                                                                                                    | Information                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Join a Voice Channel](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/voice-actions/join-a-voice-channel)                           | Using this action you can join the bot to a voice channel on your server.                                      |
| [Leave a Voice Channel](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/voice-actions/leave-a-voice-channel)                         | This block will force the bot to leave a voice channel.                                                        |
| [Voice Move a Member](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/voice-actions/voice-move-a-member)                             | With this block you are able to move any user to a different voice channel than the one they are currently in. |
| [Voice Kick a Member](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/voice-actions/voice-kick-a-member)                             | This block will force kick a user from a voice channel.                                                        |
| [Voice Mute or Unmute a Member](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/voice-actions/voice-mute-or-unmute-a-member)         | Using this block you can mute or unmute a user who is currently participating in a voice channel.              |
| [Voice Deafen or Undeafen a Member](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/voice-actions/voice-deafen-or-undeafen-a-member) | Using this block you can deafen or undeafen a user who is currently participating in a voice channel.          |


# Join a Voice Channel

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FgTOi9aaKdoypuCGU9Q9r%2Fimage_2024-05-30_163736721.png?alt=media&amp;token=9dfab387-79a8-4421-a72b-9ac73642b29e" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Join a Voice Channel action block will force the bot to join the specified channel, whether it is the voice channel you are currently in, a channel option, or a channel ID.

## Voice Channel

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FxEhZjrcmg66u2SzsFa7g%2Fimage_2024-05-15_195728533.png?alt=media&amp;token=e78479f0-699c-4112-99d0-dc5d72375b1c" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="The voice channel of the user" %}
This will force the bot to join the voice channel of the user who clicked a [button](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-attached-buttons/buttons) / [menu option](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-a-select-menu/menu-option) or is running the command / event. This will only work if the user is in a voice channel before running the command / event.
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Channel Option" %}
Selecting the channel option will prompt you with a new field to input your channel option variable. Only [channel options](/custom-commands-and-events/options/channel-option) will work in this field, use channel IDs / Variables in [#voice-channel-id](#voice-channel-id "mention").

### Channel option

Input your option variable into the field below.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FsuzPxqjDTG7eCB0H0lbz%2Fimage_2024-05-15_200449174.png?alt=media&amp;token=a37c0df4-a405-4627-9836-17fc9ce18d8d" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FaPorub5xT30U3eK51nDt%2Fimage_2024-05-15_200614707.png?alt=media&amp;token=b56da0f7-1379-45b2-b93b-4a2d156abc62" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Voice Channel ID" %}
Selecting the channel ID type will prompt you to enter the ID.

### Channel ID

The channel ID can be a [variable](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) as well. Remember this has to be a plain ID with no extra symbols or spaces, it is case sensitive like every other ID field. If you use a variable, make sure it returns a plain ID.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fec4f8UMFu60Bmi7NRM3x%2Fimage_2024-05-15_200945815.png?alt=media&amp;token=b2f1607d-5ba5-42e7-a264-b444bb2904b1" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

## Enable Success/Error Handles

Enable Success / Error Handles to detect success and errors inside of the action block. This allows you to run different actions if something goes wrong with your action. Inside of the handle, there are 2 different paths which are used to detect the outcome of the action. The green path on the bottom left side of the block indicates success, while the red path on the bottom right side of the block indicates error. You may attach action blocks to each side of the handle to get the outcome of your action block.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FfEZAijxwiWs3yk4C3iLK%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=52ffafb0-0e8c-4980-a111-0999d8451789" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Success/Error Handles feature includes 3 different error variables you can use to get information on why the action block encountered an error. Check them out [here](/custom-commands-and-events/variables#error-variables).

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FgBCbX0HtGmaNhGXARsoA%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=57dbe5f3-6efc-47af-9022-5196739573c3" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>


# Leave a Voice Channel

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FCOdvykjIgy3XIe61wjeR%2Fimage_2024-05-30_163715235.png?alt=media&amp;token=fdb90965-1866-4817-985c-764d07d09ace" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Leave a Voice Channel action block will force the bot to leave the channel it is connected in, optionally specifying the server ID.

{% hint style="warning" %}
Keep in mind the bot has to be in a voice channel for this block to work
{% endhint %}

## Optional Server ID

This action block contains one setting: Optional Server ID.

Having a server ID in this field will force the bot to look for a specific server to leave from. Leaving this blank will force the bot to leave the voice channel in the server the command / event was triggered in or [button](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-attached-buttons/buttons) / [menu option](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-a-select-menu/menu-option).

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F3CcXZolLILRawNKE7EyE%2Fimage_2024-05-17_191448248.png?alt=media&amp;token=779530c3-8f48-4845-9695-f17c4bacd660" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Enable Success/Error Handles

Enable Success / Error Handles to detect success and errors inside of the action block. This allows you to run different actions if something goes wrong with your action. Inside of the handle, there are 2 different paths which are used to detect the outcome of the action. The green path on the bottom left side of the block indicates success, while the red path on the bottom right side of the block indicates error. You may attach action blocks to each side of the handle to get the outcome of your action block.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FfEZAijxwiWs3yk4C3iLK%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=52ffafb0-0e8c-4980-a111-0999d8451789" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Success/Error Handles feature includes 3 different error variables you can use to get information on why the action block encountered an error. Check them out [here](/custom-commands-and-events/variables#error-variables).

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FgBCbX0HtGmaNhGXARsoA%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=57dbe5f3-6efc-47af-9022-5196739573c3" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>


# Voice Move a Member

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FogP3OxUYpVZKAkyQ15QO%2Fimage_2024-05-30_163557825.png?alt=media&amp;token=3033ef95-6e9e-4a1d-a47c-4c8e3d0aa95d" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Voice Move a Member action block will allow the bot to move the specified member, who is already in a voice channel, to a different voice channel.

{% hint style="warning" %}
Keep in mind the user has to be in a voice channel for this block to work
{% endhint %}

## User

This field will allow you to specify which user the bot will be moving.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FUfZLMwsv7nlS51h4d4G6%2Fimage_2024-05-17_192258208.png?alt=media&amp;token=7cca4602-0b8f-4fc9-b461-12ff09e547eb" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="The user who triggered the command" %}
This selection will move the user who is triggering the command / event or is clicking a [button](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-attached-buttons/buttons) / [menu option](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-a-select-menu/menu-option).
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="User Option" %}
Selecting "user option" will allow the bot to move a user selected from the option in the command, to a different voice channel.

### User option

You must have a user option added in the command in order for this field to work.\
Only [user options](/custom-commands-and-events/options/user-option) may be used in this field, IDs and [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can be used in [#user-id](#user-id "mention")

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FdsQFIgvUVOOeQEnn719E%2Fimage_2024-05-17_193623070.png?alt=media&amp;token=2fa51888-14c7-411a-b8c7-d1a47e3b59e5" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Firw7V4EI9RYVlxHyJx0P%2Fimage_2024-05-17_192934324.png?alt=media&amp;token=f15cc063-fd02-4aec-b5d1-18aaf54adab2" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="User ID" %}
This selection will allow the bot to move a user who is already in a voice channel, just like the other selections, but it will target a specific user ID or [variable ](/custom-commands-and-events/variables)that contains a user ID.

### User ID

This field accepts any plain user ID with no extra symbols or spaces. The ID can be in the form of a [variable ](/custom-commands-and-events/variables)as well.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FCVP9Si5nM92T7O2zhvrQ%2Fimage_2024-05-17_193951867.png?alt=media&amp;token=0fceff0c-ac9c-41e4-afa0-77ce0a96f154" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F76VnxJOPpJpctSaL9RDF%2Fimage_2024-05-17_194149016.png?alt=media&amp;token=217d6544-35ed-4e83-97eb-45e3c357f7cf" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

## Voice Channel

This field is the specified voice channel that the user will be moving to.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FszFSMvJ5hc5TaKPZ6HYv%2Fimage_2024-05-17_194445161.png?alt=media&amp;token=7c1616bf-4e92-4839-8a00-bafe69a8b7aa" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="The voice channel of the user who triggered the command" %}
This channel type will move the user to the same voice channel that they triggered the command / event in or clicked a [button](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-attached-buttons/buttons) / [menu option](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-a-select-menu/menu-option).
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Channel Option" %}
Selecting this channel type will move the user to the voice channel that is selected in the command through the channel option.

### Channel Option

This field requires a [channel option](/custom-commands-and-events/options/channel-option) in your command. Like other option fields, only the channel option variables can be used in this field. ID's / [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can be used in [#channel-id](#channel-id "mention")

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FzBhFYxFxIHOifHX8lttq%2Fimage_2024-05-17_200443704.png?alt=media&amp;token=b57b0fdb-b072-418a-92e4-9c0486199c8b" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FNokEdbeR2Ay0zZ75T90g%2Fimage_2024-05-17_200256699.png?alt=media&amp;token=d2bbe99d-c934-4f85-8ab7-544192727427" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Channel ID" %}
This selection will move the user into a voice channel specified by a channel ID.

### Voice Channel ID

The channel ID can be a [variable](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) as well. Remember this has to be a plain ID with no extra symbols or spaces, it is case sensitive like every other ID field. If you use a variable, make sure it returns a plain ID.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FdWnz8ZVBlhpKmKGrTTJG%2Fimage_2024-05-18_010655293.png?alt=media&amp;token=a772d042-1c0e-4f41-a89d-e52890b4e425" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F1VVMfg5oxRIcmh9RH0iz%2Fimage_2024-05-18_010611857.png?alt=media&amp;token=a4ccc178-29a4-4360-8456-3676a1f19adc" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

## Optional Reason

This field is an optional reason of why the bot is moving this user to a different voice channel. This reason will appear in your server's Audit Log. [Variables ](/custom-commands-and-events/variables)can be used as well.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FnxKrsf4TUDnOBj3iGkaL%2Fimage_2024-05-18_010819426.png?alt=media&amp;token=9514836a-bd8e-4617-b0bb-6885d29f81b6" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Optional Server ID

This field is an optional server ID to search for the user in. Leave blank to find the user in the server the command was triggered in or who clicked a [button](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-attached-buttons/buttons) / [menu option](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-a-select-menu/menu-option). [Variables ](/custom-commands-and-events/variables)can be used in this field and it must be a plain server ID that is returned.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F4eM8X9qiYTsSqVQ6DzHj%2Fimage_2024-05-18_011216661.png?alt=media&amp;token=1c6a6f62-f59d-4212-8c8f-9d28ead2d273" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Enable Success / Error Handles to detect success and errors inside of the action block. This allows you to run different actions if something goes wrong with your action. Inside of the handle, there are 2 different paths which are used to detect the outcome of the action. The green path on the bottom left side of the block indicates success, while the red path on the bottom right side of the block indicates error. You may attach action blocks to each side of the handle to get the outcome of your action block.

# Voice Kick a Member

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FIwn7kc1MMgf2GtRdusKk%2Fimage_2024-05-30_163534328.png?alt=media&amp;token=d20f5277-e222-4210-b5fd-c54108b39448" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Voice Kick a Member action block will allow you to kick the specified user from a voice channel, and you can add specifications to which user the bot will kick.

{% hint style="warning" %}
Keep in mind the user has to be in a voice channel for this block to work
{% endhint %}

## User

This field will allow you to specify which user the bot will be kicking.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F1uzpx00HDNED1yFA36VI%2Fimage_2024-05-18_011530533.png?alt=media&amp;token=3cb50416-23ee-474b-bea3-9b2f15fecd63" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% endtab %}

{% tab title="User Option" %}

## Optional Reason

## Optional Server ID

This field is an optional server ID to search for the user in. Leave blank to find the user in the server the command was triggered in or who clicked a [button](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-attached-buttons/buttons) / [menu option](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-a-select-menu/menu-option). [Variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can be used in this field and it must be a plain server ID that is returned.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FEc6SLFOF84NfyeISGcXx%2Fimage_2024-05-18_012250008.png?alt=media&amp;token=38202cc8-93ee-4c26-b4b2-262c246e0b06" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Enable Success/Error Handles

Enable Success / Error Handles to detect success and errors inside of the action block. This allows you to run different actions if something goes wrong with your action. Inside of the handle, there are 2 different paths which are used to detect the outcome of the action. The green path on the bottom left side of the block indicates success, while the red path on the bottom right side of the block indicates error. You may attach action blocks to each side of the handle to get the outcome of your action block.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FfEZAijxwiWs3yk4C3iLK%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=52ffafb0-0e8c-4980-a111-0999d8451789" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Success/Error Handles feature includes 3 different error variables you can use to get information on why the action block encountered an error. Check them out [here](/custom-commands-and-events/variables#error-variables).

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FgBCbX0HtGmaNhGXARsoA%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=57dbe5f3-6efc-47af-9022-5196739573c3" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>


# Voice Mute or Unmute a Member

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FkXtUzD7ukjUfG4BPKV5v%2Fimage_2024-05-30_163506255.png?alt=media&amp;token=e039c253-515d-4ccb-951c-d7041d0f4c9f" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Voice Mute or Unmute a Member action block will allow you to mute or unmute the specified user inside of a voice channel, not allowing them to speak or allow them to speak.

{% hint style="warning" %}
Keep in mind the user has to be in a voice channel for this block to work
{% endhint %}

## User

This field will allow you to specify which user that the bot will be muting or unmuting.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fn2ooF9BsMIfcOm9aNl0D%2Fimage_2024-05-18_012833920.png?alt=media&amp;token=d0f796c9-37a1-4c11-9b85-97326f84bead" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="The user who triggered the command" %}
This selection will mute or unmute the user who is triggering the command / event or is clicking a [button](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-attached-buttons/buttons) / [menu option](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-a-select-menu/menu-option).
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="User option" %}
Selecting "User option" will allow the bot to mute / unmute a user selected from the option in the command.

### User option

You must have a user option added in the command in order for this field to work.\
Only [user options](/custom-commands-and-events/options/user-option) may be used in this field, IDs and [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can be used in [#user-id](#user-id "mention")

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F8VB9fbH9axjWFyZkSNHl%2Fimage_2024-05-18_013125734.png?alt=media&amp;token=b9c06cdd-8770-44c0-8681-3613bbaac509" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FV9hgHrGAhSuKMK5SXU7P%2Fimage_2024-05-18_013221107.png?alt=media&amp;token=692ac2d9-83af-4c65-a72f-4679bbe99716" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="User ID" %}
This selection will allow the bot to mute / unmute a user who is in a voice channel, just like the other selections, but it will target a specific user ID or [variable ](/custom-commands-and-events/variables)that contains a user ID.

### User ID

This field accepts any plain user ID with no extra symbols or spaces. The ID can be in the form of a [variable ](/custom-commands-and-events/variables)as well.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FuHTtkohOEP9bjJgVRJuB%2Fimage_2024-05-18_013740499.png?alt=media&amp;token=32938620-eeea-499e-a77c-b71653113c54" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FZpJGz69BdeRNFPm0LOWD%2Fimage_2024-05-18_013814283.png?alt=media&amp;token=722c3285-1396-4b31-9ebe-66131bf280d2" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

## Mute or Unmute

This selection will allow you to decide if this action of the block will mute or unmute a specified user.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FiSJVQ9aKsiCnZYf4FU4r%2Fimage_2024-05-18_013946253.png?alt=media&amp;token=e462faed-77ae-4f51-9d0f-e89c66496102" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Optional Reason

# Role Actions

Role actions allow the bot to manage the roles in your servers through various means, such as editing, deleting and creating new roles. These actions only pertain to roles and target users aside from managing a role.

{% hint style="info" %}
You must have the manage roles permission enabled in your server for your bot for these blocks to work.
{% endhint %}

| Block                                                                                                       | Information                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Add Roles](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/add-role)                                      | This action allows the bot to add one or more roles to any server member.                                     |
| [Remove Roles](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/remove-role)                                | This action allows the bot to remove one or more roles to any server member.                                  |
| [Add Roles to All Users](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/add-roles-to-all-users)           | This action will add one or more roles to all users in the server.                                            |
| [Remove Roles from All Users](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/remove-roles-from-all-users) | Use this to remove one or more roles from all server members.                                                 |
| [Create a role](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/create-a-role)                             | This action allows you to create a role within your server.                                                   |
| [Delete a role](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/delete-a-role)                             | Using this action, you can delete a role on your server.                                                      |
| [Edit Role](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/edit-role)                                     | Using this action you can edit specific information (such as name, color or permissions) of an existing role. |


# Add Roles

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Frcyk9PDwxMWhCguTzCXT%2Fimage_2024-05-30_163407539.png?alt=media&amp;token=d1b93b02-52ff-4136-add5-26629a8925ec" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Add one or more roles to a server member. You can specify role IDs and target members in specific ways.

{% hint style="warning" %}
The bot must have the Manage Roles permission and a higher position than the role your trying to assign via the bot.
{% endhint %}

## Member

This field can specify which ways you would like to target a server member to give them roles. See specifications below.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FuHGRYyMDES1cf40olFLa%2Fimage_2024-05-20_134743665.png?alt=media&amp;token=b7b2c2aa-c1f3-4d26-9f2b-5c724293c2de" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="Member who used the command" %}
Select this option to add the selected roles to the member who triggered the command / event or clicked a [button](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-attached-buttons/buttons) / [menu option](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-a-select-menu/menu-option).
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Member Option" %}
Select this option to add the selected roles to the member who was selected in a [user option](/custom-commands-and-events/options/user-option). Only [user options](/custom-commands-and-events/options/user-option) in this field may work, IDs and [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can be used in [#member-id](#member-id "mention").

### User Option

This field requires a user option to be inside your command.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FMwC7ZPTdNReJ9Soea3zf%2Fimage_2024-05-20_004357926.png?alt=media&amp;token=60a9b65a-87d8-4d30-b1e0-774a7caddc9a" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FvPSD8HhzDZlhO2OEaJEc%2Fimage_2024-05-20_004303204.png?alt=media&amp;token=4c843240-1c63-4b5e-82f4-9dc5e6a6d5e0" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Member ID" %}
Select this option to add the selected roles to a targeted user ID or [variable](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) that contains a user ID.

### User ID

This field accepts a plain user ID or [variable](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) that returns a plain user ID. This user ID can't have any spaces or extra symbols, make sure it is a plain user ID.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FHV9ZTG8tH5VIgbIKZ5WU%2Fimage_2024-05-20_005140594.png?alt=media&amp;token=451572b4-a90f-41cc-bf4c-8c0eb798f8f8" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F7BGTcYMk5yQaaetngF8E%2Fimage_2024-05-20_005204582.png?alt=media&amp;token=7dc30d0e-e488-4f77-8dac-2679e7719672" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

## Roles Selector

Click the "+" icon to select the server roles you want to add to the user. You are also able to select a created role option from the [create a role](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/create-a-role) block. It will show under "Command Options" in the second image below.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F6o5hC72ZtSllaE1MPSZn%2Fimage_2024-05-20_005601803.png?alt=media&amp;token=ddf67b5d-8910-415c-9b21-2c1f4ac574e8" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

If you don't see the role you are looking for, it was most likely added very recently to your server. Click the refresh icon in the top right corner of the image below and it will refresh the selection to find the role.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FHXEmrLUPjOYZps6WPpSG%2Fimage_2024-05-20_005730817.png?alt=media&amp;token=1526e210-685a-4d17-abe5-6afa2bcc3d93" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## **Additional Roles**

In this field you can add additional roles in the form of plain role IDs only. This field is commonly used to add specific role IDs / [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables). As the field description states, each role ID or variable must be separated by a comma.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FadYFW4TnX8SuRdRfHBan%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=fc05a9e0-0149-46ea-86d6-9b0fac2ff0c8" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FvRkwTUD8H5WHX7SoI3ge%2Fimage_2024-05-20_134839800.png?alt=media&amp;token=fde0a177-f751-4796-ba77-ac5a045c736e" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Enable Success/Error Handles

Enable Success / Error Handles to detect success and errors inside of the action block. This allows you to run different actions if something goes wrong with your action. Inside of the handle, there are 2 different paths which are used to detect the outcome of the action. The green path on the bottom left side of the block indicates success, while the red path on the bottom right side of the block indicates error. You may attach action blocks to each side of the handle to get the outcome of your action block.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FfEZAijxwiWs3yk4C3iLK%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=52ffafb0-0e8c-4980-a111-0999d8451789" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Success/Error Handles feature includes 3 different error variables you can use to get information on why the action block encountered an error. Check them out [here](/custom-commands-and-events/variables#error-variables).

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FgBCbX0HtGmaNhGXARsoA%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=57dbe5f3-6efc-47af-9022-5196739573c3" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>


# Remove Roles

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FPqVxZcRTh25OVPQrOjzA%2Fimage_2024-05-30_163344713.png?alt=media&amp;token=238a4477-2261-42a9-b8eb-44503ac15117" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Remove one or more roles from a server member. You can specify role IDs and target members in specific ways.

{% hint style="warning" %}
The bot must have the Manage Roles permission and a higher position than the role you're trying to remove.
{% endhint %}

## Member

This field can specify which ways you would like to target a server member to remove roles. See specifications below.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F57tEeA4CCgCJAoKG9MXP%2Fimage_2024-05-24_184204718.png?alt=media&amp;token=94b97b10-3cd2-4812-a78b-76f8c5e828e5" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="Member who used the command" %}
Select this option to remove the selected roles to the member who triggered the command / event or clicked a [button](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-attached-buttons/buttons) / [menu option](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-a-select-menu/menu-option).
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Member option" %}
Select this option to remove the selected roles to the member who was selected in a [user option](/custom-commands-and-events/options/user-option). Only [user options](/custom-commands-and-events/options/user-option) in this field may work, IDs and [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can be used in [#member-id](#member-id "mention").

### User Option

This field requires a user option to be inside your command.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fe9FEfl2FXp7ua7DPuzng%2Fimage_2024-05-24_184544012.png?alt=media&amp;token=7b65e373-7b89-4ca2-bcb2-eab03e5b029d" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FUxBTuhAiOHH90FnYZkNc%2Fimage_2024-05-24_184657811.png?alt=media&amp;token=73f5dc46-d1ea-4c0f-a2d7-d132d33b3d53" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Member ID" %}
Select this option to remove the selected roles to a targeted user ID or [variable](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) that contains a user ID.

### User ID

This field accepts a plain user ID or [variable](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) that returns a plain user ID. This user ID can't have any spaces or extra symbols, make sure it is a plain user ID.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FlbtXRiWJxUwU6VDNZ43f%2Fimage_2024-05-24_184816189.png?alt=media&amp;token=11ccffc1-7267-4885-ae1a-892861e68c5b" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FctsghhHBOUc6xF7RhsTK%2Fimage_2024-05-24_184836468.png?alt=media&amp;token=5e2745ec-f0aa-4065-ab40-69435d43452c" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

## Roles Selector

Click the "+" icon to add roles to select the server roles you want to remove from the user. You are also able to select a created role option from the [create a role](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/create-a-role) block. It will show under "Command Options" in the second image below.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F6o5hC72ZtSllaE1MPSZn%2Fimage_2024-05-20_005601803.png?alt=media&amp;token=ddf67b5d-8910-415c-9b21-2c1f4ac574e8" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

If you don't see the role you are looking for, it was most likely added very recently to your server. Click the refresh icon in the top right corner of the image below and it will refresh the selection to find the role.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FHXEmrLUPjOYZps6WPpSG%2Fimage_2024-05-20_005730817.png?alt=media&amp;token=1526e210-685a-4d17-abe5-6afa2bcc3d93" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## **Additional Roles**

In this field you can add additional roles in the form of plain role IDs only. This field is commonly used to add specific role IDs / [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables). As the field description states, each role ID or variable must be separated by a comma.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FCcEZ6QLhLIMNbEaNgJb0%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=5fce767d-b3fa-488b-9bf4-2badf05e4b80" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FvRkwTUD8H5WHX7SoI3ge%2Fimage_2024-05-20_134839800.png?alt=media&amp;token=fde0a177-f751-4796-ba77-ac5a045c736e" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Enable Success/Error Handles

Enable Success / Error Handles to detect success and errors inside of the action block. This allows you to run different actions if something goes wrong with your action. Inside of the handle, there are 2 different paths which are used to detect the outcome of the action. The green path on the bottom left side of the block indicates success, while the red path on the bottom right side of the block indicates error. You may attach action blocks to each side of the handle to get the outcome of your action block.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FfEZAijxwiWs3yk4C3iLK%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=52ffafb0-0e8c-4980-a111-0999d8451789" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Success/Error Handles feature includes 3 different error variables you can use to get information on why the action block encountered an error. Check them out [here](/custom-commands-and-events/variables#error-variables).

# Add Roles to All Users

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FpJ3js5n8GAJM4hYmMCfz%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=e44ebfff-741e-453c-9e36-cf31c631d86d" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Add a role to all members of a server. You can specify role IDs and users affected in specific ways.

{% hint style="warning" %}
The bot must have the Manage Roles permission and a higher position than the role your trying to assign via the bot.
{% endhint %}

## Roles Selector

Click the "+" icon to select the server roles you want to add to all users.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F6o5hC72ZtSllaE1MPSZn%2Fimage_2024-05-20_005601803.png?alt=media&amp;token=ddf67b5d-8910-415c-9b21-2c1f4ac574e8" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## **Additional Roles**

In this field you can add additional roles in the form of plain role IDs only. This field is commonly used to add specific role IDs / [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables). As the field description states, each role ID or variable must be separated by a comma.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FadYFW4TnX8SuRdRfHBan%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=fc05a9e0-0149-46ea-86d6-9b0fac2ff0c8" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FvRkwTUD8H5WHX7SoI3ge%2Fimage_2024-05-20_134839800.png?alt=media&amp;token=fde0a177-f751-4796-ba77-ac5a045c736e" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Reason

This is an optional field. In this field you can input a reason why you are adding a role to everyone in the server. This reason will be shown in your server's audit log. [Variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can also be used in this field.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FJb9apz1BHvfaTA02Drik%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=e9f8c9e4-440d-4b5e-a48d-349c9130b0c6" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Server ID

In this optional field you can enter the ID of a server that you want to run the action in. This way, you can target servers without triggering a command or event in there. [Variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can also be used in this field.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F8wMj3dVBtXcEtDscbSSF%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=6d4f8187-55a8-4e70-a98a-7393ca30eedc" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Bot Filtering

In this selection menu you can enter whether or not you want the bot to ignore other bots, meaning the role will not be added to bots in your server.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FFg5T15re8hbrIn75J14S%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=89e58f49-8e69-4cdd-91e1-35868a8649ee" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% hint style="danger" %}
This action will add the selected roles to ALL users in the server. This operation cannot be undone and may take time for large servers. Use with caution.
{% endhint %}


# Remove Roles from All Users

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FK35Vx8hsrNLN2YFWB7tc%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=03d61789-905c-4c73-805e-7ef4f1aa7116" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Remove a role from all members of a server. You can specify role IDs and users affected in specific ways.

{% hint style="warning" %}
The bot must have the Manage Roles permission and a higher position than the role your trying to remove via the bot.
{% endhint %}

## Roles Selector

Click the "+" icon to select the server roles you want to remove from all users.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F6o5hC72ZtSllaE1MPSZn%2Fimage_2024-05-20_005601803.png?alt=media&amp;token=ddf67b5d-8910-415c-9b21-2c1f4ac574e8" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## **Additional Roles**

In this field you can add additional roles in the form of plain role IDs only. This field is commonly used to add specific role IDs / [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables). As the field description states, each role ID or variable must be separated by a comma.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FadYFW4TnX8SuRdRfHBan%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=fc05a9e0-0149-46ea-86d6-9b0fac2ff0c8" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Reason

This is an optional field. In this field you can input a reason why you are removing a role from everyone in the server. This reason will be shown in your server's audit log. [Variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can also be used in this field.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FJb9apz1BHvfaTA02Drik%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=e9f8c9e4-440d-4b5e-a48d-349c9130b0c6" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Server ID

In this optional field you can enter the ID of a server that you want to run the action in. This way, you can target servers without triggering a command or event in there. [Variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can also be used in this field.

## Remove all Roles

You can enable this section if you wish the bot to remove all roles from all users in a server. This will ignore all settings above.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FSVbcTTtm4xP35doeGLxb%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=f4afb421-dd42-47dd-a491-af793f166618" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% hint style="danger" %}
This action will remove the selected roles from ALL users in the server. This operation cannot be undone and may take time for large servers. Use with caution.
{% endhint %}


# Create a role

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F0MnXCNfdPSXhhJflZcfu%2Fimage_2024-05-30_163317504.png?alt=media&amp;token=3ca50f48-18da-4014-98c7-cc6b9d8e4d40" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Create a new Role in the server. You can choose various modifications to enhance the role or leave some fields blank to be default.

{% hint style="warning" %}
The bot must have the Manage Roles permission in order to create a role.
{% endhint %}

## Name

This field will set the name of the role that the bot will create. [Variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can be used in this field.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FMcvjbpeRubA2yjQdrxm0%2Fimage_2024-05-24_185845801.png?alt=media&amp;token=e4824358-f501-4383-bdc7-ed40b1315118" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Reason

This field is an optional reason for creating the new role. This reason will show in the audit log of the server that the command / event was executed in. [Variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can be used as well.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FkOJnJBGuKGPuURZDt1o9%2Fimage_2024-05-24_185937000.png?alt=media&amp;token=d6b90196-1572-4265-80b8-d7be6d1502e3" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Position

This field is optional and changes the position of the new role in your server. Leave this blank for default positioning. Positions are all arranged from bottom (default) to top. This field only accepts integers and [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can be used.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fjp6IIIxj3kyHiPFHzfyp%2Fimage_2024-05-24_190237629.png?alt=media&amp;token=d1887e14-fdd1-4208-bde4-f49ec69f2ed7" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Color

This field is optional and changes the color of the role the bot is creating. **This field only accepts a HEX format.** Server members use the color of the highest position role they have. [Variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can be used. Leaving this field blank will make it a default grey color.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FDhOHoCEHSi0mdZrs4YCf%2Fimage_2024-05-24_191102344.png?alt=media&amp;token=a70a07a0-b704-42f6-8d4d-a9ccef33f0d8" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Hex format example: #af5555

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FltWh6LlX918G7re80rJo%2Fimage_2024-05-24_191021136.png?alt=media&amp;token=430578ca-20b8-4a23-a02d-ab86ff1bdfcc" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## **Display role members separately from online members**

This switch controls whether the role is hoisted or not.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F4oL03lw56YUFmyT5wTEL%2Fimage_2024-05-24_192310141.png?alt=media&amp;token=ca6f5dfd-7134-4d57-967a-a21ee53aa220" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FhVq9VDz4E1XE4jMWJ5eb%2Fimage_2024-05-24_192655490.png?alt=media&amp;token=90f3b749-4fad-4b60-a693-619ccf3b6663" alt=""><figcaption><p>Blue role is not hoisted</p></figcaption></figure>

## Mentionable

This switch will allow anyone to mention / @ this role, even if they don't possess the mention @everyone / @here permission.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FZhVSJj4mcdK5pkB5o7jI%2Fimage_2024-05-24_193218427.png?alt=media&amp;token=b790414c-a351-4718-ae61-6eee1869507d" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FQBJaTGFWWkEd2MWTfwLF%2Fimage_2024-05-24_193316848.png?alt=media&amp;token=a83246ec-e544-436d-99ea-4760fcf2458d" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Permissions

Click the "+" to attach certain permissions to the role the bot is creating. Leave this field blank to have no permissions. Visit this [link](https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/permissions#permissions-bitwise-permission-flags) to learn more about permissions.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FxTFAToEoKFPJtI3eDpJN%2Fimage_2024-05-24_193547707.png?alt=media&amp;token=910331c9-5561-4ea4-898f-e4f1d7b88377" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Enable Success/Error Handles

Enable Success / Error Handles to detect success and errors inside of the action block. This allows you to run different actions if something goes wrong with your action. Inside of the handle, there are 2 different paths which are used to detect the outcome of the action. The green path on the bottom left side of the block indicates success, while the red path on the bottom right side of the block indicates error. You may attach action blocks to each side of the handle to get the outcome of your action block.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FfEZAijxwiWs3yk4C3iLK%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=52ffafb0-0e8c-4980-a111-0999d8451789" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Success/Error Handles feature includes 3 different error variables you can use to get information on why the action block encountered an error. Check them out [here](/custom-commands-and-events/variables#error-variables).

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FgBCbX0HtGmaNhGXARsoA%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=57dbe5f3-6efc-47af-9022-5196739573c3" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>


# Delete a role

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F8Gjf25VJRRMdoksl9yMw%2Fimage_2024-05-30_163248965.png?alt=media&amp;token=cbc257db-54c9-4228-842f-cc988b35f1a0" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Delete a Role in the server. You can specify specific roles from your server or an ID / [Variable](/custom-commands-and-events/variables).

{% hint style="warning" %}
The bot must have Manage Roles permission in order to delete roles.
{% endhint %}

## Role Type

This selection will specify the targeted role to delete.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FBA0oClcVFExGT5B9Zqz0%2Fimage_2024-05-24_194138906.png?alt=media&amp;token=690a83be-1161-4414-9ca4-9dc31c7d4712" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="Specific Role " %}
This selection will allow you to select a specific role from your server to delete. It will show a dropdown menu to allow the selection.

### Specific Role

This is a dropdown menu allowing you to select a role from any server the bot is in. Remember that if the role you're trying to select isn't there, it most likely means it was very recently added, simply click the refresh icon next to the "?" in the image below to find your role.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FiozUg2rh0dgSCrtSMoSp%2Fimage_2024-05-24_194458436.png?alt=media&amp;token=1407f886-7b85-4701-b324-7a78aab2606c" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Role ID or Variable" %}
This selection can target specific roles by their ID to delete. Selecting this type will prompt a new field to appear to input a ID or [Variable](/custom-commands-and-events/variables).

### Role ID or Variable

This field accepts a plain role ID or [variable](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) that returns a plain role ID. This role ID can't have any spaces or extra symbols, make sure it is a plain role ID.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FopDqiC3P54vBfYDzxI18%2Fimage_2024-05-24_195301330.png?alt=media&amp;token=b0f01809-d1ef-45e7-be3f-dff41bf4c3b5" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FmfdrynyZdUq2lI6HesoZ%2Fimage_2024-05-24_195234283.png?alt=media&amp;token=ee6a5c20-bc8f-4b60-9c52-ff488824b789" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

## Enable Success/Error Handles

Enable Success / Error Handles to detect success and errors inside of the action block. This allows you to run different actions if something goes wrong with your action. Inside of the handle, there are 2 different paths which are used to detect the outcome of the action. The green path on the bottom left side of the block indicates success, while the red path on the bottom right side of the block indicates error. You may attach action blocks to each side of the handle to get the outcome of your action block.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FfEZAijxwiWs3yk4C3iLK%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=52ffafb0-0e8c-4980-a111-0999d8451789" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Success/Error Handles feature includes 3 different error variables you can use to get information on why the action block encountered an error. Check them out [here](/custom-commands-and-events/variables#error-variables).

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FgBCbX0HtGmaNhGXARsoA%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=57dbe5f3-6efc-47af-9022-5196739573c3" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>


# Edit Role

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FJxfFYNMO9hXg3ezRHYw7%2Fimage_2024-05-30_163221062.png?alt=media&amp;token=8457b086-66f0-4e75-8640-e6a62a50ea4d" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Edit a role block will edit a role in your server. Editing can modify different aspects of an already existing role. Some fields can be left blank for no changes to occur.

## Role

This selection will specify the method of targeting the role that will be edited.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FCri2h82un2g7kY3jB8gg%2Fimage_2024-05-24_195720596.png?alt=media&amp;token=a0178e6a-7a5f-46a4-8db8-bd13d89bce02" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="Role Option" %}
This selection will target a [role option](/custom-commands-and-events/options/role-option) which will contain the role for the bot to delete when the command is executed. Only [role options](/custom-commands-and-events/options/role-option) in this field may work, IDs and [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can be used in [#role-id](#role-id "mention").

### Role Option

You must have a [role option](/custom-commands-and-events/options/role-option) added in your command for this to work.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F9Cfp6MJBChWv3lxRrvqS%2Fimage_2024-05-24_200226855.png?alt=media&amp;token=37ecda12-14a7-487f-97ad-db836e7cc0ab" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FlqHy84w1FIIuvsJGgpyX%2Fimage_2024-05-24_200203375.png?alt=media&amp;token=f02d9c70-50ac-40f2-8f16-24684a6bdcf2" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Role ID" %}
This selection will target a specific role ID / [variable](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) to delete.

### Role ID

This field accepts a plain role ID or [variable](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) that returns a plain role ID. This role ID can't have any spaces or extra symbols, make sure it is a plain role ID.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FqSZdDUprEpDx7SPF2hSe%2Fimage_2024-05-24_200808120.png?alt=media&amp;token=e0fbe693-527e-4905-8b05-4efe0ef3152d" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FgDK0Tx5cWFtrrEB7c5nU%2Fimage_2024-05-24_200944462.png?alt=media&amp;token=6a8bd930-5a25-4fe7-9fa5-b848020bc7e8" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

## Name

The new name for the role the bot is editing. Leave this blank if you do not wish to change the name.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FrIVyy904gVF8FqKO69Ev%2Fimage_2024-05-24_201208337.png?alt=media&amp;token=3792c132-5ea1-48cb-acc3-30447ce8638e" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Reason

This field is an optional reason for editing the role. This reason will be shown in the audit log of the server that the command / event was executed in.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FgbP4j3MuBYRSrbIXoqud%2Fimage_2024-05-24_201400171.png?alt=media&amp;token=92737607-5078-4910-b806-0c23991e292d" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Position

This field is optional and changes the position of the edited role in your server. Leave this blank for default positioning. Positions are all arranged from bottom (default) to top. This field only accepts integers and [variables ](/custom-commands-and-events/variables)can be used.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FbTagcCovr0oCglkdYmAh%2Fimage_2024-05-24_201606495.png?alt=media&amp;token=3e42c896-9ff2-4ddb-af0e-1c2ad49fcc2d" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Color

This field is optional and changes the color of the role the bot is editing. **This field only accepts a HEX format.** Server members use the color of the highest position role they have. [Variables ](/custom-commands-and-events/variables)can be used as well. Leaving this field blank will make it a default grey color.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FOEaFn9K4P6IY3D3CQ4jg%2Fimage_2024-05-24_201811296.png?alt=media&amp;token=ea73d950-debe-43ec-ba3b-c193018cbf62" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Hex format example: #af5555

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FltWh6LlX918G7re80rJo%2Fimage_2024-05-24_191021136.png?alt=media&amp;token=430578ca-20b8-4a23-a02d-ab86ff1bdfcc" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Display role members separately from online members

This switch controls whether the role is hoisted or not.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F4oL03lw56YUFmyT5wTEL%2Fimage_2024-05-24_192310141.png?alt=media&amp;token=ca6f5dfd-7134-4d57-967a-a21ee53aa220" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FhVq9VDz4E1XE4jMWJ5eb%2Fimage_2024-05-24_192655490.png?alt=media&amp;token=90f3b749-4fad-4b60-a693-619ccf3b6663" alt=""><figcaption><p>Blue role is not hoisted</p></figcaption></figure>

## Mentionable

This switch will allow anyone to mention / @ this role, even if they don't possess the mention @everyone / @here permission.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fv4xHKsXf2Ot6Pp6yLuGv%2Fimage_2024-05-24_202148352.png?alt=media&amp;token=57987c77-8bec-469c-a5da-a374c7cb3ba7" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FQBJaTGFWWkEd2MWTfwLF%2Fimage_2024-05-24_193316848.png?alt=media&amp;token=a83246ec-e544-436d-99ea-4760fcf2458d" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Permissions

Click the "+" to attach certain permissions to the role the bot is editing. Leave this field blank to have no permissions. Visit this [link](https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/permissions#permissions-bitwise-permission-flags) to learn more about permissions.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FJVzCeSb1tldcuwkBFhFs%2Fimage_2024-05-24_202300033.png?alt=media&amp;token=95bf3e6a-4b1d-4e6c-a463-18efd62a3129" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Enable Success/Error Handles

Enable Success / Error Handles to detect success and errors inside of the action block. This allows you to run different actions if something goes wrong with your action. Inside of the handle, there are 2 different paths which are used to detect the outcome of the action. The green path on the bottom left side of the block indicates success, while the red path on the bottom right side of the block indicates error. You may attach action blocks to each side of the handle to get the outcome of your action block.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FfEZAijxwiWs3yk4C3iLK%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=52ffafb0-0e8c-4980-a111-0999d8451789" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Success/Error Handles feature includes 3 different error variables you can use to get information on why the action block encountered an error. Check them out [here](/custom-commands-and-events/variables#error-variables).
