# Change a members nickname

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F8aXDkvvrLFmbqMvXBuA3%2Fimage_2024-05-30_162632121.png?alt=media&amp;token=8931cf65-9a18-44d0-8ec0-662ef0877b29" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

This action block changes the nickname of a member in a server. You can specify / target a specific user to change the nickname of.

{% hint style="warning" %}
Warning: The bot must have Change Nickname permissions to be able to change a member(s) nickname.
{% endhint %}

## Member

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="User who used the command" %}
If this type is chosen, the bot will change the nickname of whoever executed the command / event or who clicked the [button](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-attached-buttons/buttons) / [menu option](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-a-select-menu/menu-option).
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="User Option" %}
Selecting "user option" will change the nickname of the user selected inside the command from the user option.

### User option

You must have a user option added in the command in order for this field to work.\
Only [user options](/custom-commands-and-events/options/user-option) may be used in this field, IDs and [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can be used in [#user-id](#user-id "mention")

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fe4XboJYvadFhron0hqSG%2Fimage_2024-05-28_232522304.png?alt=media&amp;token=b0079091-dd43-49ea-a099-a326731f2386" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FzZeYAgCxtnxyV4nqSX1K%2Fimage_2024-05-28_232632493.png?alt=media&amp;token=8c8a208d-7348-4884-8f04-cba389666d71" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="User ID" %}
This selection will change the nickname of the user and it will target a specific user ID or [variable ](/custom-commands-and-events/variables)that contains a user ID.

### User ID

This field accepts any plain user ID with no extra symbols or spaces. The ID can be in the form of a [variable ](/custom-commands-and-events/variables)as well.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FoY1GDiUrnnYnkizXOx2o%2Fimage_2024-05-28_232823250.png?alt=media&amp;token=670cd01e-680b-4ab4-b20b-895ac536b258" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FK3BIOwkZZh3EPrfCvKDY%2Fimage_2024-05-28_232849219.png?alt=media&amp;token=7e1a45de-26a1-48fe-8303-f3950ad2f711" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

## New Nickname

This field is the new nickname that you want to change the user’s nickname to. You can use [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) and [options](/custom-commands-and-events/options) inside this field.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fw7zudeMVsB29dELT9Crb%2Fimage_2024-05-28_233034439.png?alt=media&amp;token=4889bd1f-6f5b-49f2-aadf-9d1eaf452ef9" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Reason

This is an optional field. In this field you can input a reason why you are changing a members nickname. This reason will be shown in your server's audit log. [Variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can also be used in this field.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F4Gs3kK73qeyGqEZx45qP%2Fimage_2024-05-28_233145558.png?alt=media&amp;token=e99b0804-b908-4879-aefc-28035d24d377" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Enable Success/Error Handles

Enable Success / Error Handles to detect success and errors inside of the action block. This allows you to run different actions if something goes wrong with your action. Inside of the handle, there are 2 different paths which are used to detect the outcome of the action. The green path on the bottom left side of the block indicates success, while the red path on the bottom right side of the block indicates error. You may attach action blocks to each side of the handle to get the outcome of your action block.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FfEZAijxwiWs3yk4C3iLK%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=52ffafb0-0e8c-4980-a111-0999d8451789" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Success/Error Handles feature includes 3 different error variables you can use to get information on why the action block encountered an error. Check them out [here](/custom-commands-and-events/variables#error-variables).

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FgBCbX0HtGmaNhGXARsoA%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=57dbe5f3-6efc-47af-9022-5196739573c3" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>


# Purge Messages

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FA4UQJnRj7e0fwhBn5Kyb%2FScreenshot%202026-09-29%20152609.png?alt=media&amp;token=c30005e1-f676-4e87-b097-11ad6f720169" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The purge messages action block will allow you purge a specific amount of messages in a specfic channel.

{% hint style="warning" %}
If messages are older than 14 days, they can't be deleted, unless you're deleting only 1 message.
{% endhint %}

## **Channel**

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FiJ0LzBk7sOfOgD37vjXy%2FScreenshot%202026-09-29%20152720.png?alt=media&amp;token=8b6224e9-e5c5-4002-b240-e47de800cfd1" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="This channel" %}
This type will purge messages in the channel that the command / event was executed in or where a [button](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-attached-buttons/buttons) / [menu option](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-a-select-menu/menu-option) was clicked.
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="A specific channel" %}
Selecting this option will target a specific channel you choose to purge messages in.

### **From a block**

Allows you to select the channel to purge messages in from a channel/thread the bot created within this command/event.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fe95UggQ2tgtjlmTZvP7h%2FScreenshot%202026-09-29%20153039.png?alt=media&amp;token=14136637-eba7-452a-854a-b19e0b8c4ad0" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### From the server

Allows you to select a specific channel from a server the bot is in.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FEyhxxMAXoNgroU5XqdLq%2FScreenshot%202026-09-29%20153407.png?alt=media&amp;token=f1a526d9-68d2-4a72-98fb-410c7270aa19" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### ID or variable

Allows you to input a plain channel ID / [variable](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) or a [channel option](/custom-commands-and-events/options/channel-option).&#x20;

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FnhTdG6YfoaGvvw3YNRdU%2FScreenshot%202026-09-29%20153813.png?alt=media&amp;token=4f907475-274e-4a69-93ed-a7d9f4931048" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

## **How many**

This field is the amount of messages that will be purged. It only accepts integers / [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) that return a integer.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FGQ3WkDph2tYEokJgnWwm%2Fimage_2024-05-29_125018136.png?alt=media&amp;token=f1d8e9b0-88bd-4c3e-8e8f-fa35e06ca2af" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FolW7kgLqiRcNPHszhsf8%2FScreenshot%202026-09-29%20153851.png?alt=media&amp;token=43508835-adc6-4bdf-8bf3-7f519a81600b" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Keep Pinned Messages

This toggle will allow you to have the bot ignore messages that are currently pinned when purging.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F85Hhv7GArLlK8KbMzWe9%2FScreenshot%202026-09-29%20152147.png?alt=media&amp;token=3e4517a1-721e-46b9-afc1-5a3561069d23" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Enable Success/Error Handles

Enable Success / Error Handles to detect success and errors inside of the action block. This allows you to run different actions if something goes wrong with your action. Inside of the handle, there are 2 different paths which are used to detect the outcome of the action. The green path on the bottom left side of the block indicates success, while the red path on the bottom right side of the block indicates error. You may attach action blocks to each side of the handle to get the outcome of your action block.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FXJukIW21fkpAUVhBZuUe%2FScreenshot%202026-09-29%20154016.png?alt=media&amp;token=82f061bf-b6ec-4552-a4c3-23174d92c457" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Success/Error Handles feature includes 3 different error variables you can use to get information on why the action block encountered an error. Check them out [here](/custom-commands-and-events/variables#error-variables).

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FCTajDafBgqWJ2Oz831Cr%2FScreenshot%202026-09-29%20154042.png?alt=media&amp;token=94876512-2f42-4ecc-a305-16d75d7fd844" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>


# Create Server Invite

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FVlDmi8VEAx7pD4MTTcjN%2Fimage_2024-05-30_162530953.png?alt=media&amp;token=4699e3e8-e931-45b7-b4eb-7c9a77725bc4" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Create Server Invite block is self explanatory and creates a server invite for a specific server.

## Channel

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F85CnyPtqziCBubVmmk00%2Fimage_2024-05-29_224315718.png?alt=media&amp;token=6242a8a5-0a14-4991-95b5-d384ff59bac6" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

This dropdown menu is the channel target for the server invite. You will have the three standard options to choose from.

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="Channel the command was run in" %}
If this type is selected, the server invite will be targeted towards the channel the command / event was run in.
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Channel Option" %}
Selecting "channel option" will have the server invite target the channel a user selected inside the command from the [channel option](/custom-commands-and-events/options/channel-option).

### Channel Option

You must have a channel option added in the command in order for this field to work.\
Only [channel options](/custom-commands-and-events/options/channel-option) may be used in this field, IDs and [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can be used in [#channel-id](#channel-id "mention")

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F5rdPq6KDtIDxsrMcdFIG%2Fimage_2024-05-29_224552535.png?alt=media&amp;token=7b82426c-8688-480e-821b-322108cc5b3d" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fi3JoTasmPuIMMSg60Vi0%2Fimage_2024-05-29_224643665.png?alt=media&amp;token=275f2c37-101d-4463-ab0d-25caf66d6cfe" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Channel ID" %}
This type selected from the dropdown will have the server invite target a specific channel ID or [variable ](/custom-commands-and-events/variables)that contains a channel ID.

### Channel ID

This field accepts any plain channel ID with no extra symbols or spaces. The ID can be in the form of a [variable ](/custom-commands-and-events/variables)as well.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FYR9HnaRveZq5mZQvRXHx%2Fimage_2024-05-29_224849627.png?alt=media&amp;token=4316d9a2-466a-4da3-baa7-77af3aba244b" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F4ECOOKIk9SM10aK7nUA8%2Fimage_2024-05-29_224908297.png?alt=media&amp;token=b6663859-759d-49aa-8a3e-871448e9353a" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}

## Invite Duration

This field is modifies how long the server invite will be valid (in seconds) for until expiration. The field only accepts integers, 0 being the duration is infinite. [Variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) can be used.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FsNhGSj6sBzXXtdfF5g8A%2Fimage_2024-05-29_225145940.png?alt=media&amp;token=0fe1435d-daab-4e09-b3c4-9e057c949e5e" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Max Uses

Similar to the duration field, this field is the number of uses the invite can have until it is unusable. Likewise, it only accepts integers and [variables](/custom-commands-and-events/variables). Having it set to 0 will make the amount of uses infinite.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fwe39qM4rZLuAiRzaeMde%2Fimage_2024-05-29_225425642.png?alt=media&amp;token=2218bd47-3886-4215-9a35-8dff428e4d8a" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Temporary

This dropdown menu represents a temporary kick system. If the user doesn't receive a role in 24 hours upon them joining off the invite created, they will be kicked. You can enable to disable this by making them temporary or not.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FPy3y03XC81dlYQng1Zoj%2Fimage_2024-05-29_225704675.png?alt=media&amp;token=6febf493-2a3a-4333-afdf-5ccb7a26b5d4" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Unique Invite

This dropdown menu represents whether the invite is unique or is based off another invite. If the "user a existing invite" is selected, then the bot will create the invite with similar settings based off other invites in that server.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FecN2J6yFKRSqdSedPLMX%2Fimage_2024-05-29_230050849.png?alt=media&amp;token=040e26d9-5628-4809-b9fb-0b1c4cea9cc1" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Optional Server ID

This field is where you input a plain server ID to for the server invite to target the channel in. This field can be left blank to target the server of wherever the command / event was triggered in or where a user clicked a [button](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-attached-buttons/buttons) / [menu option](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/legacy-reply-actions/send-a-message-with-a-select-menu/menu-option). A [variable](/custom-commands-and-events/variables) containing a plain server ID that has no spaces or extra symbols can be used as well.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FohCQCl5NB4jhWgrDcidm%2Fimage_2024-05-29_230307642.png?alt=media&amp;token=87ac7a61-4329-4ece-ae77-fde430f31440" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Invite Variable

This field is however the variable that returns the server invite URL will be returned. This is similar to the [set a unique variable](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/other-actions/set-a-unique-variable) block, so you can name your variable whatever you wish inside {}. You can then use this invite variable in later actions.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FmiWN7aP6bncEyonrVJMh%2Fimage_2024-05-29_230815249.png?alt=media&amp;token=3316392c-9fa7-429b-a874-bb1978a50759" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Enable Success/Error Handles

Enable Success / Error Handles to detect success and errors inside of the action block. This allows you to run different actions if something goes wrong with your action. Inside of the handle, there are 2 different paths which are used to detect the outcome of the action. The green path on the bottom left side of the block indicates success, while the red path on the bottom right side of the block indicates error. You may attach action blocks to each side of the handle to get the outcome of your action block.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FfEZAijxwiWs3yk4C3iLK%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=52ffafb0-0e8c-4980-a111-0999d8451789" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Success/Error Handles feature includes 3 different error variables you can use to get information on why the action block encountered an error. Check them out [here](/custom-commands-and-events/variables#error-variables).

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FgBCbX0HtGmaNhGXARsoA%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=57dbe5f3-6efc-47af-9022-5196739573c3" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>


# Leave Server

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FG8gpdTjf1cnGeiAsAsSx%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=ec2e7a13-eee0-49da-8127-b4e9d0da5539" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

With the "Leave Server" action you can force the bot to leave a server. Please note this action cannot be undone and the bot will need to be re-invited to rejoin the server, so consider adding a confirmation step before using this action.

## Target Server

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FOQ5GwD4wV1WOlHUTT42L%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=15ec2f50-6de7-4792-9e57-047711b699da" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

This dropdown menu is the channel target for the server invite. You will only have two options to choose from.

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="Current Server" %}
If this type is selected, the bot will leave the server where the command has been ran.
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Server ID" %}
If this type is selected, the bot will leave the server entered in the field below by ID or variable.

## Server ID

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FvNkk44EE5f8ylN0Zbj5h%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=93a6651b-d186-42fe-8dfa-68507603d960" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

In this field you can enter the server ID or variable of the server that you want to leave with the bot.
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}
